messages:
anya (eng): Postmortem up — short: token rotation + concurrent model-reg metadata requests caused vendor auth 429s, cascading into hosted inference errors (~8m). Link: https://redwood.in/postmortems/1943509999
max (sre): We saw auth 429s spike at 21:03 UTC then cache misses amplified traffic.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor opened ticket VEND-10012 and wants request samples and timeline.
maria (security): Action: audit rotation schedule and add jitter. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-03-31.
anya (eng): Short-term: add in-process token cache + single-flight refresh to avoid parallel refresh storms. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-03-24.
max (sre): Add circuit-breaker on auth calls + alert when auth 429/5xx > 4% for 2m. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-26.
prakash (product): Add incident tag "external-auth-throttle" to track recurrence and include in next risk digest. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-28.
leo (vendor-relations): Proposed dry-run with vendor to validate our fallback and circuit-breaker. Tentative dates: 2026-04-10 or 2026-04-12. I'll confirm by 2026-03-29.
anya (eng): I'll attach a 2-min trace and a safe curl snippet in the postmortem doc.
maria (security): Also require KMS/HSM verification steps in runbook before test. I'll PR runbook. ETA: 2026-03-25.
max (sre): Ops checklist for dry-run: 1) staging throttle 2) enable circuit-breaker 3) run CI harness 4) monitor SLOs. I'll draft and share.
prakash (product): Customer comms: draft short note for enterprise contacts if we run the dry-run. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-30.
anya (eng): Long-term: explore dual-auth-path (backup internal token service) as mitigation. Spike owner: anya. ETA: 2026-05-01.
max (sre): I'll own the action tracker and close items as PRs land.
leo (vendor-relations): Thanks — I'll push vendor for a grace window during tests and request adjusted rate-limit guidance.
anya (eng): End thread."
